auto_accept.condition: reviewer_verdict == SUPPORTED AND confidence >= 0.90 AND gate_reason has no specific-defect prefix

rejected_options.reason: halves accept volume, zero accuracy gain (16/16 vs 16/16)

simulated_metrics_burned_v1.note: Development-only shadow simulation over 120 core rows; never a certification claim.
simulated_metrics_burned_v1.deterministic_path: RC1 auto rows without reviewer output re-run through RC2 engine + auto_gate: 0 autos (all engine-CONTRA, and CONTRA never autos), 16 review. Includes the symmetric-policy false-CONTRA autos RC1B-0176/0178, eliminated by the no-CONTRA rule.
simulated_metrics_burned_v1.tradeoff: Conservative soundness-first: fewer, provably-clean autos; overall scores dip because previously-correct CONTRA autos (46 rows) now go to review. Correctness of the auto channel is the pre-freeze priority. Overall numbers use the strict scorer (review rows score correct only when the expected action is review/abstain).

calibration_set_sanity.note: RC2 engine (not fusion) run over calibration-set.json: 48/84 = 0.571 exact-verdict accuracy; deterministic layer remains review-heavy by design. Fusion operates only on reviewer output, which calibration set has no model for; therefore fusion was NOT tuned on the calibration set and burned V1 evidence is labeled development-only.
